# Viacheslav-Illia Detsyk

> Third-year Informatics and Computer Engineering student at FEUP, University of Porto. Based in Porto, Portugal. Seeking a backend engineering internship.

## Education

- B.S. in Informatics and Computer Engineering, FEUP.
- Expected graduation: February 2028.

## Selected personal projects

- [OBMINNIK](https://github.com/slavik-ua/obminnik): Go trading platform with a limit order book, price-time priority, partial fills, cancellation, fixed-point settlement, PostgreSQL transactions, an outbox relay, Kafka-compatible Redpanda, Redis Pub/Sub, WebSockets, Prometheus, Grafana, and a Next.js dashboard.
- [BitTorrent client](https://github.com/slavik-ua/BitTorrentClient): Go client with bencode parsing, HTTP/UDP trackers, peer protocol over TCP sockets, concurrent downloads, SHA-1 piece verification, retries, cancellation, and resume. Tested with scripted peers, Go's race detector, and a local tracker and Transmission peers. The local test network runs with Docker Compose.
- [HTTP/1.1 server](https://github.com/slavik-ua/httpfromtcp): Go server using TCP sockets with custom request parsing, a state-aware response writer, chunked responses, static files, and a streaming proxy that emits a SHA-256 checksum in HTTP trailers.

## Open-source contribution

- [Merged Linux kernel patch](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/commit/05998d64426a8f245f267bafee434d8cb00a5cb6): added a DMI quirk to the AMD ACP6x audio driver to enable the built-in microphone on Acer Nitro AN16-41 laptops. Merged November 2026. This was a small hardware compatibility change.
